evidence: queue body: 'NO FRESH ROWS: Hy-Vee has a headless lane and the 08:00 capture ran, but it contributed ZERO rows dated 2026-09-23'; its 09-24 recurrence says the same

items.root_cause: carried from plan-2026-09-25-2: Get-HyVeeAskOrder ranks by last successful READ, and a refused ask keeps the row old and uncovered, so the same 20 refused products fill the 20-ask budget every day

root_fix.what: order Hy-Vee asks by the last ASK as well as the last read, and park a refusal that cannot change until its input changes
root_fix.exact_change: the plan-2026-09-25-2 patch: Update-HyVeeAskLedger / Read-HyVeeAskLedger / Test-HyVeeAskParked / Get-HyVeeSizeConflictParked, -AskLedger and -Today on Get-HyVeeAskOrder (sort within a rank by max(as_of, last_asked); a size conflict parked at rank 4 until its worklist size moves; no-offer and no-row below-tag refusals re-promoted at 7 days), header fields asked_repeat_of_yesterday, asked_previous_run, size_conflict_parked, and the ledger write after the file lands under Enter-TcLedgerLock and Write-TcAtomicFile. The watchdog half is not in this change.

(2) capture-watchdog.ps1 still says NO FRESH ROWS / saw nothing where 'ANSWERS REFUSED' would be clearer, and has no SAME SLICE detector; the same promote-until-success shape in Get-WalmartRulingOwed and the sale-fallback asks is unmeasured. proof.must_fire_case: FROZEN from the 09-24 file (budget 13): the OLD order returns the same refused products (livelock reproduced and asserted); the new order holds every never-asked product and no size-conflict pid. AT THE BAR: a no-offer refusal is re-promoted at exactly 7 days and not at 6.
proof.clean_twin: with an EMPTY ledger the new order equals the old order on 5 of 5 existing fixtures; a missing ledger file reads as empty; a parked size conflict unparks when its worklist size changes.
proof.run: -SelfTest: exit 0, 108 ok lines, 0 FAIL, last line 'SELF-TEST PASS'. -DryRun before (no ledger): order above, 19 of 20 refused pids; -DryRun after (ledger seeded from the 09-25 capture_terms, 20 entries, 14 carrying a size, scratch only): 'ask ledger entries=20 parked=16', order 536497, 4145663, 2526087, 299680, 2973867, 393598, 3794446, 3644206, 55979, 3432897, 3603868, 129138, 1820677, 11153, 3731139, 282855, 17440, 57033, 23563, 5161: 0 of the 19 refused pids, 19 of 20 slots freed.
